newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan likely to move towards continued growth - EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan likely to move towards continued growth - EPA.

text.p: The Japanese economy is likely to move towards continued growth as a self-sustainable recovery centring on private demand is achieved, Economic Planning Agency Minister Taro Aso said on Thursday.

"Although economic growth may be gradual in the first half of this fiscal year due to the effects of a revision in taxes, we think that a path towards continued growth will be cleared as a self-sustainable recovery centring on private demand is achieved along with economic structural reforms," Aso told a regional bankers' conference.
He added that the government will keep a careful watch over economic movements and take flexible and appropriate steps in in managing the economy.
Corporate capital spending, especially among manufacturers, is recovering and net exports are increasing, Aso said.
Despite the impact from the consumption tax increase, consumer spending is on a gradual recovery trend and housing investments are steady. Production is on a rising trend, he said.

The favourable cycle of rising production leading to better employment conditions and demand is functioning, Aso said, adding that even though the tempo of the economic recovery may slow for a short while, economic recovery centring on steady domestic demand is continuing.
